ai_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has received a demand order from GST authorities for ₹1.18 crore, plus unquantified interest, related to alleged excess Input Tax Credit utilization for FY 2020-21. Although the company disputes the order and plans an appeal, claiming no immediate financial impact, this represents a material contingent liability and a potential red flag regarding tax compliance. The unquantified interest further adds uncertainty to the ultimate financial exposure if the appeal is unsuccessful.
